My experience staying at Hotel Dream Palace in Jagatpuri, Delhi was truly exceptional. The rooms were clean and comfortable and I felt safe and secure during my entire stay. The price was also very reasonable for the level of service that I received. I would highly recommend Hotel Dream Palace to anyone looking for a great place to stay.

There is a big scam going on now a days.
Once you book hotel online and reach the location the property owner will ask you extra money and in case you don’t wish to pay the extra amount they wont allow you to stay.

Recently booked the room in this property and had to pay extra 300 in order to stay.

Blankets and bedsheets were torn and smelly. Room was dirty as hell. Somehow spent the night.

I would strongly suggest you not to book the room here.

Also don’t make the payment in advance while booking. Go to the property, check everything then book.
